spec.name: Hassani Culture Tent Forum
spec.description: Annual gathering organized by the National Forum for Hassani Heritage (Al Muntada al-Watani lil-Turath al-Hassani) in Rabat, showcasing Hassani (Saharan) poetry, music and traditional 'khaimas' (tents), paired with academic lectures on Hassani identity and Morocco's African depth.

recurrence.note: Organized in Rabat by the National Forum for Hassani Heritage; exact month has varied by year (May 2022, November 2024, December 2025)

editions.notes: Held at Bahnini Hall, Rabat; coincided with celebrations of Rabat as Islamic World Capital of Culture 2022 and the Crown Prince's birthday
A 2nd edition was reported by multiple outlets around October 2023, but no fetchable page confirming exact dates was found; flagged for follow-up verification.
Held at Morocco's National Library and Mohammed V National Theatre, Rabat, under the theme 'The new development model in service of Hassani culture and its African depth'; honorary partner Mali
Held at Morocco's National Library, Rabat, under the theme '50 years since the Green March... Hassani culture at the forefront of national constants'; guest of honor Senegal
